verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows RunAnywhere letting users version, review, or roll back automations. The SDK's tool-calling loop and the versioned hosted API base (/v1) are adjacent features, not version control or rollback for user automations. The docs also note there is no changelog or deprecation policy. Because a developer AI platform could plausibly offer this, the axis applies and the lack of evidence yields none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
